paragraphs.en: A [[curious]] [[theme]] runs through modern [[society]] [[across]] every [[routine]] of daily [[conduct]].
The [[whole]] picture is not always [[visible]], yet we [[seem]] to [[live]] in an age of constant change.
[[Actually]], we [[deem]] it [[normal]] to [[seek]] [[vivid]] stories [[beyond]] our own immediate circle.
We [[attach]] great importance to [[cultural]] shifts and [[collective]] memory.
The [[time]] has come to ask what truly [[matter]]s, and [[here]] we must be honest.
The digital [[renaissance]] is [[unfolding]] at [[unimaginable]] speed.

A single [[spark]] can trigger a [[cascade]] of [[media]] [[streaming]] through global [[bandwidth]], from the [[tablet]] in a child's hand to the [[cell]] tower on a [[rural]] hill and the [[orbiter]] crossing the sky.
This [[system]] [[converge]]s with every aspect of existence.
Its [[origin]] lies in military research, yet it has grown by leaps and bounds.
A [[bang]] of innovation echoes through every [[inch]] of the globe, and we can [[divert]] its flow or [[remodel]] its structure.
We [[celebrate]] the [[celebrity]] who considers fame a [[vocation]], yet we [[suspect]] that [[bias]] shapes our views.
It is [[good]] to question the [[default]] settings of culture, [[lest]] we follow the [[herd]] without reflection.
Some [[custom]]s deserve respect; others are mere [[nonsense]].
We must [[orient]] ourselves toward a [[virtuous]] [[pathway]].
No single model can [[match]] every situation, and we should [[add]] new ideas carefully.
The [[investigator]] of human nature finds [[inborn]] traits and [[instinctive]] drives.
Yet [[theology]] and [[secular]] philosophy both explore [[holiness]] and morality.
A [[pater]] may [[feed]] his child with [[herb]]s from the garden, but he also feeds the mind.
We should not [[curse]] our limitations or [[fantasize]] about a [[paradise]] elsewhere.
Even the ancient [[god]] of the mountain has been replaced by reason.
In the [[cave]] of ancient history, humans painted on walls.
Later, [[medieval]] scholars studied [[mathematics]] and [[doctrine]].
Today, a [[graduate]] may compose a [[paper]] on philosophy.
The [[instructor]] gives [[tuition]] to the [[patient]] student.
A [[bilingual]] [[reader]] can enjoy [[fiction]] from many cultures.
The [[letter]] remains a powerful tool.
A [[visit]] to the library reveals [[non-standard]] manuscripts that are truly [[noteworthy]].
Historians [[reconstruct]] the past from fragments.
Our communities face a [[difficult]] [[problem]]: how to [[govern]] without becoming [[oppressive]].
The [[congress]] holds [[congressional]] debates; the [[unionist]] speaks for the [[union]]; the [[voter]] casts a ballot.
Yet [[uninformed]] citizens may [[polarize]] debates.
A [[cunning]] leader may [[hijack]] the agenda, or even [[highjack]] a movement.
We must [[defy]] such tactics.
The public grows [[anxious]] under [[attack]] from misinformation.
A [[leading]] newspaper provides one [[indication]] of the mood, while officials remain [[unresponsive]].
Tensions [[erupt]] from [[grassroots]] anger, and the streets are [[seething]].
A [[wilful]] denial of reality and a [[willful]] refusal to compromise only [[fierce]]ly deepen divisions.
Economic life involves [[customer]]s, [[goods]], and [[wholesale]] trade.
A [[homebuyer]] may [[bid]] on a house; a [[paycheck]] determines one's [[pocketbook]].
To [[cut]] costs is often [[burdensome]], and a [[mean]] policy can [[degrade]] workers.
We should [[encourage]] fair [[pay]] and [[reasonableness]].
A [[timely]] [[measure]] can prevent crisis.
The national [[bill]] reaches a [[billion]] dollars, and [[gross]] inequality persists.
Companies [[hire]] and fire at will, while the [[storehouse]] of opportunity seems locked.
Many choose [[less]] rather than more.
Health and environment demand attention.
A [[fever]] can strike the [[body]]; a [[swab]] can detect disease.
[[Therapy]] helps us [[recover]].
On the [[grassland]], an [[animal]] may roam.
A [[sweater]] keeps us warm; a [[thermostat]] regulates temperature.
We must not [[erase]] the [[thick]] forests or spoil the [[thin]] air.
Children learn to [[swim]] in clear lakes and wear a warm [[coat]] in winter.
The [[swing]] of seasons brings both rain and sunshine.
Technology brings both promise and peril.
We need [[mandatory]] safeguards to [[minimize]] risk.
The [[volunteer]] firefighter shows [[good-natured]] courage; the [[patrol]] keeps streets safe.
A mobile phone is a [[cute]] device, but [[unfocused]] use wastes hours.
We should [[suspend]] distractions and [[keep]] our goals in view.
Travelers pack a [[carry-on]] bag and face [[involuntary]] delays.
Even a [[time-limited]] offer can pressure us into poor choices.
Education is a [[vital]] [[bridge]] to opportunity.
[[Each]] student deserves a [[level]] playing field.
A [[sensible]] teacher adapts to individual needs.
We should not let costs [[hinder]] talent.
A [[degree]] opens doors; a [[hobby]] enriches life.
The [[field]] of knowledge is [[wide]].
We should [[widen]] access for all.
Cultural life is a [[mixture]] of old and new.
We honor tradition while embracing change.
A [[prophet]] may predict the future; an artist may create beauty.
The [[grace]] of a dancer, the [[rustle]] of leaves, the [[whistle]] of a bird—all inspire us.
A [[tune]] can lift spirits.
A [[census]] counts people; the press informs them.
We should [[reconsider]] harsh judgments and [[recollect]] our shared humanity.
In the [[centre]] of town, the [[center]] of attention may shift quickly.
What seems [[meaningless]] to one generation becomes [[hip]] to the next.
Personal growth requires effort.
We must [[endure]] hardship.
It is hard to admit mistakes, but [[self-conscious]] reflection helps.
Do not [[swear]] in anger.
Instead, try to [[win]] trust.
A calm person listens.
[[Few]] people achieve greatness without [[sweat]].
The road is long, but [[peace]] awaits those who persist.
With [[minimal]] effort, we can achieve little.
We cannot [[anymore]] pretend that all problems are [[solvable]].
[[Unfortunately]], some wounds never fully heal.
Relationships shape our lives.
A [[mate]] shares joy and sorrow.
A [[female]] leader may [[chair]] a meeting.
A [[widow]] may [[outlive]] her spouse.
We should value every connection.
[[Gossip]] can destroy trust; [[unpleasant]] words wound.
A kind [[note]] can brighten a day.
We should nourish friendships.
Let us [[bind]] ourselves to one another with respect.
The natural world teaches humility.
The [[interior]] of the earth remains [[unexplored]].
[[Wild]] rivers [[sweep]] through valleys.
We should [[sail]] the seas with care.
Every [[grain]] of sand matters.
The [[cycle]] of seasons [[recur]]s.
[[Energy]] is precious.
We must not waste it.
The climate is changing.
We face great challenges.
[[Certain]] species adapt to [[adjoining]] habitats, while others perish.
Justice and freedom require vigilance.
[[Liberty]] is not free.
We must protect it.
[[Unilateral]] actions often fail.
A wise policy considers the [[maximum]] good.
We should reduce harm.
Required service can help.
The law applies to all.
Workers may organize.
Every citizen has a voice.
We should foster participation.
A legal [[case]] may set a [[norm]], and we [[ought]] to follow [[formally]] established rules.
The future remains unwritten.
We [[will]] shape it.
Our [[legacy]] depends on present choices.
Let us [[think]] deeply.
Let us [[see]] clearly.
Let us act with wisdom.
The [[end]] is not yet determined.
Though the road ahead may [[curve]] unexpectedly, we should not feel [[embarrassed]] by our past mistakes or fear [[defeat]].
Even in [[awkward]] moments, we grow.
